thesis: ASO is extended after a +46% 63-day run, trades above the mean analyst target, and offers only about 1.2 reward/risk into a 52-week high only 3% away. The last bar reversed from a new high of 71.81 to close 69.47, which hints at supply at resistance. Revenue growth is decelerating while the stock is a consumer-cyclical retailer in a confirmed risk-off regime with rising yields. There is no sourced catalyst for the rally, so persistence cannot be judged, and earnings on Dec 8 add gap risk. Short interest near 20% of float raises the odds of sharp reversals in both directions.
